title: Web Development

seo.title: Web Development | Julie Zimmerman
seo.description: Accessible, maintainable web development integrated with content, data, APIs, performance, and operations.

hero.headline: Building useful web experiences on top of sound engineering.
intro: I build production web systems that connect interface work with data, accessibility, performance, content operations, and long-term maintenance.

My experience ranges from institutional and enterprise platforms to custom agency applications, e-commerce, real-estate search, content-rich WordPress sites, and static systems designed around privacy.

philosophy.title: Engineering Philosophy
philosophy.anchor: A web experience is only as strong as the system supporting the person using it.
principles: Interfaces should reflect real user tasks and content relationships.
Performance and resilience are part of usability.
Front-end decisions should not create avoidable operational debt.
philosophy.closing: Front-end decisions should not create avoidable operational debt.

problems.title: Problems I Solve
problems.intro: The most valuable work usually begins where a system has accumulated complexity, operational risk, or assumptions no one has revisited.
items: Custom search, mapping, forms, and editorial tools

approach.title: How I Work
paragraphs: I connect interface choices to the underlying content model, data source, browser behavior, and maintenance workflow.
I build progressively, test the critical path, and preserve clarity between presentation, business logic, and data access.

experience.summary: Lead developer and systems architect for a large, long-lived portfolio of production websites and integrations.
evidence: Technical standards, migration planning, launch QA, and incident response

experience.summary: Technical lead in enterprise higher-education software, working across large Oracle systems, performance testing, defect analysis, and release delivery.
evidence: Synthetic data generation exceeding one million records

related_writing.title: Related Writing
related_writing.intro: Case studies and essays that show the underlying engineering decisions.

business_value.title: Why integrated web engineering matters
paragraphs: Treating the interface as separate from content, data, and operations creates fragile experiences. Integrated web engineering aligns all four.
The result is a site that works for visitors, editors, and the people responsible for keeping it alive.

contact.title: Let's Talk
paragraphs: For technical leadership, architecture, modernization, or complex systems work, contact me directly.

closing_statement: Useful interfaces begin with an accurate understanding of the system behind them.
